# UniLexical (Full Documentation Context)

> Framework-agnostic, Notion-style block rich-text editor powered by Meta's Lexical engine.
> Features pure TypeScript core, thin Vue 3, React, and Vanilla JS wrappers, hover action handles, drag-and-drop block reordering, slash commands, real-time markdown shortcuts, GFM tables, and clean HTML/Markdown serialization.

---

# 1. Overview & Architecture

UniLexical is architected on a **Three-Tier Decoupled Architecture**:
1. **Core Layer (TypeScript)**: Houses the Meta Lexical instance, custom `BlockWrapperNode` and `ImageNode`, markdown shortcuts, slash menu controller, drag-and-drop mechanics, and import/export serializers. No framework dependencies exist in this layer.
2. **Reactivity & Lifecycle Bridge**: Translates Lexical's immutable update loop into lightweight framework-compatible notifications via a typed `EventEmitter`. Vue 3 wrappers isolate the instance inside `shallowRef` to prevent reactive proxy collisions; React wrappers use `useSyncExternalStore`.
3. **Framework Wrappers**: Thin adapters for Vanilla JS (`mountEditor`), Vue 3 (`<UniLexical />`), and React (`<UniLexical />`).

---

# 2. Installation & Quick Start

## Installation
```bash
# Core package
npm install unilexical

# For Vue 3
npm install unilexical vue

# For React
npm install unilexical react react-dom
```

## Styles
```ts
import 'unilexical/style.css';   // Editor UI, toolbar, slash, tippy, overlay
import 'unilexical/preview.css'; // Host-safe content preview styling (.uni-preview)
```

## Vanilla JavaScript
```ts
import { mountEditor, mountPreview } from 'unilexical';
import 'unilexical/style.css';
import 'unilexical/preview.css';

const { editor, getMarkdown, getHtml, setContent, destroy } = mountEditor({
  container: '#editor',
  placeholder: "Type '/' for commands…",
  initialContent: '# Welcome to UniLexical',
  initialFormat: 'markdown',
});

const preview = mountPreview('#preview');
preview.bindEditor(editor);

editor.on('change', ({ html, markdown }) => {
  console.log('Document updated:', { html, markdown });
});
```

## Vue 3
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { UniLexical, UniLexicalPreview } from 'unilexical/vue';
import 'unilexical/style.css';
import 'unilexical/preview.css';

const html = ref('');
</script>

<template>
  <UniLexical
    initial-content="# Vue 3 UniLexical"
    initial-format="markdown"
    @change="(payload) => (html = payload.html)"
  />
  <UniLexicalPreview :html="html" />
</template>
```

## React
```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { UniLexical, UniLexicalPreview } from 'unilexical/react';
import 'unilexical/style.css';
import 'unilexical/preview.css';

export function Editor() {
  const [html, setHtml] = useState('');
  return (
    <>
      <UniLexical
        initialContent="# React UniLexical"
        initialFormat="markdown"
        onChange={({ html }) => setHtml(html)}
      />
      <UniLexicalPreview html={html} />
    </>
  );
}
```

---

# 3. Configuration Reference (`UniEditorConfig`)

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `container` | `string \| HTMLElement` | — | Vanilla only. CSS selector or DOM element. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `"Type '/' for commands…"` | Placeholder text when document is empty. |
| `namespace` | `string` | `"UniLexical"` | Lexical namespace for clipboard isolation. |
| `editable` | `boolean` | `true` | Enable or disable editing. |
| `builtinUI` | `boolean` | `true` | When `true`, mounts built-in toolbar, slash menu, and hover overlay. Set `false` for headless. |
| `toolbarItems` | `ToolbarItemId[]` | *All features* | Subset and order of visible toolbar buttons. Omit for full toolbar. |
| `initialContent` | `string` | — | Initial document content. |
| `initialFormat` | `'html' \| 'markdown' \| 'json'` | `'markdown'` | Format of `initialContent`. |
| `imageOptions` | `ImageOptions` | `{}` | Image upload, accept types, and size validation. |
| `attachmentOptions` | `AttachmentOptions` | `{}` | File attachment upload and size validation. |
| `tableMaxSize` | `{ rows: number; cols: number }` | `{ rows: 5, cols: 5 }` | Table picker grid dimensions. |
| `theme` | `UniEditorTheme` | *Default theme* | Custom CSS class name overrides. |
| `nodes` | `Array<Klass<LexicalNode>>` | `[]` | Extra custom Lexical node classes. |
| `onCustomAction` | `() => void` | — | Handler for `'custom'` toolbar button. |

## ImageOptions
```ts
imageOptions: {
  upload: async (file: File) => {
    // Return remote public HTTPS URL string
    return 'https://cdn.example.com/image.png';
  },
  accept: 'image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/gif',
  maxSize: 8 * 1024 * 1024, // 8MB limit
}
```
*If `upload` is omitted, images are embedded directly as base64 Data URLs.*

---

# 4. API Reference (`UniEditor`)

## Content Methods
- `getContent(format?: 'json' | 'html' | 'markdown'): string`
- `setContent(content: string, format?: 'json' | 'html' | 'markdown'): void`
- `getHtml(): string` - Returns clean semantic HTML (strips internal block wrappers).
- `getMarkdown(): string` - Returns clean GFM Markdown.
- `getJson(): string` - Returns serialized Lexical EditorState JSON.
- `insertImageFile(file: File): Promise<void>`
- `insertImageUrl(src: string, alt?: string): void`
- `insertTable(rows: number, cols: number): void`

## State & Control Methods
- `setEditable(editable: boolean): void`
- `setToolbarItems(items: ToolbarItemId[]): void` - Dynamically change toolbar buttons at runtime.
- `getToolbarState(): ToolbarState` - Get snapshot of current formatting flags (isBold, isItalic, etc.).
- `setSlashItems(items: SlashMenuItem[]): void` - Customize slash popup commands.
- `execToolbar(item: ToolbarItemId): void` - Programmatically click a toolbar button.
- `focus(): void` / `blur(): void`
- `getLexicalEditor(): LexicalEditor` - Access underlying Lexical instance.
- `destroy(): void` - Full cleanup of event listeners and DOM elements.

## Events (`editor.on(name, handler)`)
- `ready`: Editor initialized and mounted.
- `change`: `{ html, markdown, json }` document mutated (debounced).
- `toolbarChange`: Selection/formatting state updated.
- `slashTriggered`: Slash popup opened, searched, or closed.
- `blockHoverChanged`: Pointer hovered over different block line.
- `paste`: Media or text pasted.
- `fullscreenChange`: Fullscreen toggled.
- `sourceModeChange`: Raw HTML source mode toggled.
- `customAction`: Custom toolbar button clicked.
- `error`: Internal Lexical transaction error.
- `destroy`: Instance destroyed.

---

# 5. Toolbar & Slash Items Catalog

## Toolbar Items (`ToolbarItemId`)
- **History**: `undo`, `redo`
- **Inline Format**: `bold`, `italic`, `underline`, `strike`, `code`, `highlight`, `subscript`, `superscript`, `painter`, `eraser`
- **Typography**: `fontColor`, `fontFamily`, `fontSize`, `lineHeight`
- **Blocks**: `heading`, `heading1` … `heading6`, `paragraph`, `quote`, `codeBlock`, `container`, `toggle`, `datetime`
- **Lists**: `bulletList`, `orderedList`, `todo`
- **Alignment**: `align`, `alignLeft`, `alignCenter`, `alignRight`, `alignJustify`, `indentIncrease`, `indentDecrease`
- **Insert**: `link`, `image`, `attachment`, `table`, `tableCellBackgroundColor`, `hr`, `break`, `emoji`, `custom`
- **View**: `sourceCode`, `fullscreen`, `printer`
- **Layout**: `divider`, `group`

## Markdown Typing Shortcuts
- `# ` to `###### `: Heading 1 to Heading 6
- `> `: Blockquote
- `- ` or `* `: Bullet list
- `1. `: Numbered list
- `- [ ] `: Checklist
- `---` or `***`: Horizontal rule
- ` ```lang `: Code block
- `:::info` / `:::tip` / `:::warning` / `:::danger`: Callout container
- `| Col A | Col B |`: GFM Table
- `**bold**`, `*italic*`, `~~strike~~`, `` `code` ``: Inline formats

---

# 6. Headless Mode & Custom UI

Set `builtinUI: false` and utilize `useLexical` to bind your custom component library or Tailwind UI:

```vue
<!-- Vue 3 Headless -->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useLexical } from 'unilexical/vue';
const { containerRef, toolbarState, execToolbar } = useLexical({ builtinUI: false });
</script>
<template>
  <button :class="{ active: toolbarState.isBold }" @click="execToolbar('bold')">Bold</button>
  <div ref="containerRef" />
</template>
```

```tsx
// React Headless
import { useLexical } from 'unilexical/react';
export function HeadlessEditor() {
  const { containerRef, toolbarState, execToolbar } = useLexical({ builtinUI: false });
  return (
    <>
      <button onClick={() => execToolbar('bold')}>Bold</button>
      <div ref={containerRef} />
    </>
  );
}
```
